TL;DR:
We ran a small set of controlled playback tests to compare dispatch semantics across edge-forward dispatch and core-tiling multiplexing.

Why we ran this (context):
- Product asks for a short, shareable comparison to inform routing policy defaults.

Experiment setup (short):
- Date: 2026-05-15 to 2026-05-17.
- Hardware: G-core (A100x2) for core tiles.
- Owner: Priya Natarajan

Results
- edge-dispatch-prefetch gives best p50 and p95 for short responses.
